pathParams.name: UnitId
pathParams.description: The unit to which the photo is attached. Note: Photos cannot be updated through this endpoint if the unit is using Unit Type photos.

pathParams.name: PhotoId
pathParams.description: Unique identifier of the photo to update

attributes.name: Position
attributes.description: The position of the photo in the unit photo gallery. The position must be a non-negative integer. If multiple photos are associated with a unit, the order of the remaining photos (positions 1 and above) will not change automatically if some photos are deleted. For example, if there are photos in positions 1, 2, 3, and 4, and photos 1 and 3 are deleted, the remaining photos will retain their original positions of 2 and 4

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the updated unit photo
